No. With this row, current ServicioSAP writes no PRIN00043 line for MA or for VIU. All three lenses reach this result, and nothing I read contradicts it.

**MA** (muebles_america, '12 M MA P INM'):
- The row passes the OrgVtas '04' filter (OM:918-920).
- Its Condicion 'Credito Viu 12M P INM' matches neither condicionSap ('12IA', from SIGMavi or the catalog at PCC:61) nor the Magento text (OM:930-933).
- The line is skipped and Orden is still used up (OM:935-939).
- LAN logic gives the same result (no line). The MA CondicionPropre is most likely 'Credito MA Pisos 12M P INM' (PCC:62), not the Viu text.
- So MA shows no difference from LAN, but only because this row's text is a VIU condition.

**VIU** (viu, '12 M VIU P INM'): the row is dropped for two reasons.
- OrgVtas '04' is not '05', so it is filtered out both on the server (FLP:90) and in memory (OM:918-920).
- Its text matches neither '12IV' nor '12 M VIU P INM'.
- LAN logic would most likely write one line: PRIN00043 x1, precio 1146, Abono 0, Orden 1, costo from spVerCosto. LAN filters only on the condition and the SKU (no UEN, Sucursal, Canal, Lista or Vigente), and DescuentoCategoria 0.00 means no CEILING (SPL:248-262).
- So VIU differs from LAN. "Most likely" because it assumes the CondicionPropre for '12 M VIU P INM' is 'Credito Viu 12M P INM'. PCC:65 suggests it is, but the SIGMavi query (Q6) has not been run.

**Both stores:**
- The header is written before the lines (OM:657).
- SEGU00001 is still written when costoEnvio > 0 (OM:887-892).
- Magento gets HTTP 200 'Concluido' (OM:1791-1796).
- The skip leaves nothing in sap.log: OM:935-939 does not log, and Logs\sap.log was last written 2026-09-17 with no SD29 entries.

**Two separate causes:**
1. **The match key (a real LAN gap, whatever happens to this row).** ServicioSAP compares SD29.Condicion with a payment-term code or the raw Magento text. LAN compared PropreListaDFinal.Condicion with VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea.CondicionPropre. So a Propre-text row is never matched, even when its OrgVtas is right, and this row shows such rows exist in 04/05. The comments at OM:826-827 and OM:927-929 say the second lookup covers descriptions. It cannot: '12 M VIU P INM' is a Magento text, not a Propre description.
2. **The OrgVtas filter.** This was your decision of 2026-09-11 (FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:347), not a LAN rule. For this row it still blocks VIU after the key is fixed.

**The row itself is inconsistent DEV test data:**
- OrgVtas 04, Sucursal 0504 (the MA credit plant, OM:377) and Descripcion 'Credito MA 12M P INM' all say MA. Only Condicion says Viu.
- Formato is 'INST Test Mayoreo 1/16'.
- Abono is 0.00. Under your 2026-09-23 rule that is a configuration matter and gets no code guard, so even a priced line would be written with Abono 0.
- It contradicts CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:214, which says the 04/05 rows carry codes.

One row for one SKU is not the 2-3 SKU capture that was requested, so P7/P8b (which row wins when several match, and multiple lines per SKU) are still open.

synthesis.lan_equivalence:
SD29 PropreListSet.Condicion is the equivalent of PropreListaDFinal.Condicion: same field name, same Propre-text style on the legacy rows and now on this 04 row. Descripcion and Descripcionarticulo have no counterpart in LAN pricing: no LAN credit pricing query (SPL:243-262, LPM:754-831) reads a description column. In this row Descripcion contradicts Condicion and is identical to Descripcionarticulo, so it is not a usable key.

How LAN priced a line (SPL:243-262):
- One INSERT...SELECT FROM PropreListaDFinal p JOIN VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea c ON c.CondicionPropre = p.Condicion WHERE c.Condicion = @Condicion AND p.articulo = @artRegion.
- @Condicion is the raw Magento text (LCM:111, :910).
- The store is decided only by the text ('12 M MA ...' / '12 M VIU ...'). There is no UEN, Sucursal, Canal, Lista or Vigente filter, and no TiendaVirtual filter.
- It reads only p.Precio, p.Abono and p.DescuentoCategoria, applying CEILING to both Precio and Abono when DescuentoCategoria > 0 (SPL:248-256).
- There is no TOP, so n matching rows give n lines with the same Orden. No match gives no line, and Orden still advances (LCM:915).
- SEGU00001 takes its own branch (precio = @SeguCost, Abono 12, SPL:179-217).
- Precioreactivado and Abonoreactivado have no LAN reader. You ruled them out on 2026-09-23 (CAP:217-221).

ServicioSAP equivalent:
- SIGMavi CondicionesCredVtaLinea is the renamed VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea (CHECKLIST_DEV3_NOSAP_NOINTELISIS.md:317; ServicioSAP already reads CondicionPropre, TiendaVirtual and Mensualidades from it in SCM:28-31 and :70-73).
- So the LAN key is: take the CondicionPropre value(s) for the Magento text, and match them against SD29.Condicion.
- The payment-term code ('12IA'/'12IV') is a legitimate SAP-side second key, because SD29 e-commerce rows also use codes (CAP:214). It has no LAN counterpart, and it must keep coming from GetCondicionAsync, which SD01 PaymentTerms also needs (OM:2229-2236).
- The current retry with the raw Magento text (OM:933, :993-998) has no LAN counterpart and has never matched any SD29 row seen so far.
- The OrgVtas 04/05 filter (OM:918-920, FLP:90) is your 2026-09-11 decision (FLUJO:347), not LAN logic.
- SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado.sql:65-74 does filter TiendaVirtual, but that SP computes the first-save amount (MIN(Precio)), not the order lines.

1. The row's Condicion is a Propre description. ServicioSAP looks for either the code (catalog '12IA'/'12IV') or the Magento text. The SIGMavi value (Q6) is unknown, but none of its plausible forms ('12IA', '12 M MA P INM', 'Credito MA ...') equals 'Credito Viu 12M P INM'.
